notes: QA pass (2026-09-21): removed the `valid: {start: '2013', end: null}` window a previous pass set. hepgraph.atlas.build._feature_segments() treats any `valid` dict with a non-null `start` as an open-ended 'active' window through build day whenever `end` is null, overriding the entity's own state_segments entirely -- so this feature was rendering `status: 'active'` in the built bundle today even though detector:muon-g-2's own sourced timeline says otherwise (status 'completed' at build day 2026-09-21, confirmed by directly testing hepgraph.atlas.build._Context.status_at_build/segments). Removing `valid` restores the intended fallback (contract SS3: 'without it the feature inherits the entity's timeline'). This is a pipeline-code gap (hepgraph/atlas/build.py `_feature_segments`), not unique to this record -- see docs/atlas-worklog/REVIEW_geometry_qa.md.
